title: closeafter=state stalls open when all live events are type-filtered
description: In events_handler, when close_after_first=true and state_replay_count=0, live_limit=1 so take(ping_offset + 0 + 1) waits for one item from live_stream. The coalescing task drops all-filtered batches silently (batch.is_empty() → continue, never sends to live_tx). If only events for non-matching types arrive on the broadcast, live_rx never delivers an item, and the stream stalls open indefinitely rather than closing. Trigger: client connects with closeafter=state&types=Message, all subsequent broadcast events are for Chat or Contact only.
